item.description:
Koegaki 1.8.1

  • The Custom words list now marks a word that will not be applied, such as a word written in Japanese, Node.js, the single letter x, or a word that a replacement already matches. One line under the word says why. It follows what you type, and the word is still saved.
  • When Koegaki restarts itself after a model update or to recover the microphone, a setting saved just before the restart is now kept. The window stops taking changes just before the new copy opens, and the new copy waits up to a few seconds for the old one to close before it reads your settings.
